Hi Paul,

I am not sure how OpenBugs works, I think it also uses mcmc.list data
structure when it returns the samples from the chains? Somewhere in
the output object you should probably be able to find the mcmc.list
object (you can run str() on it to find out). Then you can run
summary() on the mcmc.list object and your stats will be calculated. I
am using this for processing results from JAGS. You may need to type
"require(coda)" to run the summary().

Best wishes,

Tomas

messages.author: 72444bb824190d51
messages.subject: Re: issues with fitting a Jolly Seber model in OpenBUGS
parts:
Hi Paul,

The mark-recapture data appear in the model as 'y', not 'z', so your data list should begin 'y=structure(...'

The Royle & Dorazio example has 294 animals and 225 recaptures for 22 parameters.  You have only 25 animals and only 3 recaptures, and you are trying to estimate around 100 parameters: 33 each for phi, p, gamma. Even if you get it to run, I doubt it will produce anything useful. Better to try a model with constant values.

Regards, Mike
